leadText:
Bamboo Hill (Japanese: バンブーヒル Bamboo Hill) is an -exclusive location in the Alola region, found on Melemele Island. It appeared in Rise and Shine, Starship!.

In the episode, went camping there with his parents and . During that time, he came across a , which was stuck in the ground. The next day, after informing , they went to see Celesteela. With the help of a group of , the group began to excavate around Celesteela. Sophocles believed Celesteela to be the Celestial Starship from legends, but the others believed it to be an .

They returned the next day after learning from that it was indeed an Ultra Beast. Attempts were made to catch it in a Beast Ball, but all of them were unsuccessful due to its large size and the fact that it was still rooted down to the ground. After protecting Celesteela from , the Ultra Guardians were able to create a safe area for Celesteela to launch back home.
